body: LIVE method test (L9, L21): random draw (Random(20261203)) from 262 IT (38) / Chemicals (72) / Capital Goods (152) names in the India Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band at the 23-Nov-2026 close, classified by industry_map.csv (0 unclassified; prereg sha256 47b2b58e... written before the frame). SKIPS: none - HARSHA was walk #1. S2 passed: unmodified FY26 audit (auditor rotation at term end), CARE AA- (Mar-2024; no later filing found), pledge 0, promoter 75%, solvency not red (2 flags), PEAD Q5 (SUE +1.81). FINDINGS: (1) India Engineering EBITDA 22-24% but group ROIC ~11.5% and ROIIC ~11% (Romania losses, solar, ~135-day working capital, new plants) - below CoE 12.5%; (2) ~Rs 600 cr capex wave (Advantek Bhayla phases 1-2 'Rs 350 cr plus', China phase 2 ~Rs 100 cr) while Advantek runs at ~54% utilisation (Reg-30 28-May-2026); payback by utilisation vs management's 2x asset-turn route differs ~6x; (3) AGM 23-Jul-2026: 14.14% against re-appointing ID Kunal Shah = ~92% of non-promoter votes cast [EST]; (4) L40: debt 'backed by government subsidy' per the call, no grant/subsidy note in AR26; solar ALMM relaxations to Dec-2026; (5) one customer 12.6% of revenue (11.0% FY25); (6) credibility hand ledger 57% vs auto-components median 60% (numbers met, dates slip); (7) MD&A segment table mislabels the FY26 EBITDA column. VALUATION (worksheet v1.3): Rs 438.25, 24.4x trailing, 43.8x normalised; reverse DCF finds no growth path at ROIIC 14% - needs year-10 NOPAT margin 24.5% vs 9.0%; base IRR 8.7%; DCF-consistent exit P/E ~10.6 vs 24 used (EV 0.73x at DCF exits); EV 1.58x raw = anchored (w=0.5) vs hurdle 1.76x -> size 0. Both-flags (L39 addendum) not triggered (pledge 0, ICR 9.6x). Calls: 6 live + 3 card calls.
